creator.description:
This labeler checks for SynthID watermarks in images and labels them if any is detected.

This labeler does not detect images that have been intentionally modified to remove that watermark.

locales.description: This image appears to be generated by a Google Gemini-family model (Nano Banana). It was flagged by the open-source reverse-SynthID FFT detector, which analyses the image's frequency/phase profile for SynthID-style watermarks. Treat it as a strong hint that the image is AI-generated, not cryptographic proof. reverse-SynthID by Alosh Denny — github.com/aloshdenny/reverse-SynthID
locales.name: Nano Banana / Gemini (AI)

locales.description: This image appears to be generated by OpenAI's GPT-Image-2 (ChatGPT). It was flagged by an open-source learned surrogate detector trained to recognise GPT-Image-2 output. Treat it as a strong hint that the image is AI-generated, not cryptographic proof.
locales.name: ChatGPT / GPT-Image (AI)

locales.description: Opt-in: blur images this labeler flags as Google Gemini-family (Nano Banana) AI output, behind a tap-to-reveal. Off by default — enable to hide the media. Pairs with the "Nano Banana / Gemini (AI)" badge.
locales.name: Blur Gemini / Nano Banana images

locales.description: Opt-in: blur images this labeler flags as OpenAI GPT-Image (ChatGPT) AI output, behind a tap-to-reveal. Off by default — enable to hide the media. Pairs with the "ChatGPT / GPT-Image (AI)" badge.
locales.name: Blur ChatGPT / GPT-Image images
